scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @fishing-work/server" "npm run dev -w @fishing-work/draw-guess"
scripts.dev:contest: concurrently -k -n server,contest -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @fishing-work/server" "npm run dev -w @fishing-work/draw-contest"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fishing-work/draw-guess && npm run build -w @fishing-work/draw-contest && npm run build -w @fishing-work/server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @fishing-work/draw-guess && npm run lint -w @fishing-work/draw-contest
